idea: a tiny lantern fish exploring a glowing reef, flipping gravity to swim on the ceiling
creator: Ahmed
title: Lumi's Glowing Reef Flip

design.title: Lumi's Glowing Reef Flip
design.tagline: A tiny lantern fish flips upside-down to light the sleepy reef!
design.story: Lumi is a tiny lantern fish whose reef has gone dim. To relight the Grand Shell, Lumi must gather lost glow pearls hidden on floors and ceilings. With a brave flip of its belly, Lumi learns to swim upside-down and bring warm light back to every sleepy coral.

hero.name: Lumi
hero.look: Tiny round chubby lantern fish with soft teal body, aqua fins, big kind dark eyes and small smile, glowing warm yellow bulb on head stalk

world.setting: A sleepy deep-sea glowing reef of soft corals, bubble columns and arching rock ceilings for ceiling-swims
world.mood: Cozy, wondrous and calm with soft bioluminescent glow

specialMechanic.name: Ceiling Swim Flip
specialMechanic.howItWorks: Tap to flip gravity so Lumi swims on the ceiling, tap again to drop down. Flip mid-jump to reach upside-down ledges, cross gaps and dodge brambles safely.

levels.name: Bubble Coral Walk
levels.idea: Learn to run, bop grumpy urchins and flip onto low ceilings to grab first glow pearls.

levels.name: Upside-Down Grotto
levels.idea: A twisty grotto of ceilings and bramble patches where chained flips lead to the Grand Shell.

sprites.name: hero
sprites.prompt: Tiny round chubby lantern fish, soft teal body with aqua fins, big kind dark eyes and small smile, glowing warm yellow lantern bulb on short stalk, smooth rubbery texture

sprites.name: enemy
sprites.prompt: Small grumpy round spiky urchin ball, deep purple body with soft lavender tips, tiny pouty eyes, wobbly little feet, soft fuzzy texture

sprites.name: enemy2
sprites.prompt: Small translucent pink jelly puff with droopy sleepy eyes and wavy short tentacles, soft glowing dots, squishy gel texture

sprites.name: collectible
sprites.prompt: Small round glowing pearl inside a clear bubble, pale mint and white swirl, tiny sparkle highlights, smooth glassy material

sprites.name: powerup
sprites.prompt: Tiny golden plankton star cookie, warm yellow glow, smiling face, soft crumbly texture with glowing crumbs

sprites.name: goal
sprites.prompt: Large open clamshell nest in pearly pink and mint, holding a big glowing golden pearl, scalloped edges with soft glow spots

sprites.name: tile
sprites.prompt: Square dark navy reef rock block with speckled texture, topped with glowing mint algae and tiny coral nubs

sprites.name: platform
sprites.prompt: Wide flat floating coral shelf, deep blue underside with purple spots, top covered in glowing teal moss and small round polyps

sprites.name: background
sprites.prompt: Wide layered deep-sea reef panorama, dark blue silhouetted corals and arches, glowing teal and yellow dots, soft light rays from above, no characters

sprites.name: hazard
sprites.prompt: Cluster of sharp dark purple sea brambles with glowing pink tips, tangled thorny vines, glossy texture

sprites.name: flipbloom
sprites.prompt: Small swaying anemone flower with mint petals and glowing yellow center, soft rubbery texture, cheerful open face

verdict.summary: Lumi explores a bright glowing reef, jumping, collecting bubbles and hitting enemies with readable HUD and no glitches.
verdict.seen: Three shots show a glowing underwater reef with platforms, bubble collectibles, a small blue fish hero, corals, HUD with stars and hearts, and collect popups.

seasons.notes: Built Lumi's Glowing Reef Flip with gravityFlip ceiling-swim plus flipbloom flowers that flip gravity on touch, two reef levels with ceilings, pearls, urchins and snacks.

proposal.title: Lumi's Glowing Reef Flip: Season 2
proposal.pitch: Lumi returns to relight far corals with Puff Dash, a turtle buddy who guards pearls, and a dreamy Jelly Garden. Same cozy ceiling-flip, now smoother and kinder with kept pearls.

changes.what: Add Puff Dash to zip across wider gaps
changes.why: Makes traversal smooth and playful, pairs with ceiling flips for longer chains without changing core feel.

changes.what: Add sleepy baby turtle buddy who follows and holds one extra pearl
changes.why: Adds cozy companionship and soft forgiveness for new players, keeps pearl hunt gentle.

changes.what: Add floaty jelly ceilings with soft bounce in new garden stage
changes.why: Gives pretty vertical play for chained flips and safe landings, built from platform kit.

changes.what: Keep collected pearls after slipping and enlarge mobile flip button
changes.why: Reduces frustration on retry and makes flips easier on touch, keeps challenge kind.

newSprites.name: pufftrail
newSprites.role: Soft dash puff effect for Puff Dash
newSprites.prompt: Round cottony white-aqua puff cloud trail with tiny sparkles and glow pearl glints, light airy platformer effect, no sharp edges

newSprites.name: jellycap
newSprites.prompt: Soft translucent pink jellyfish cap platform with droopy frills and inner warm glow, squishy bouncy look, fits reef pastel palette

newLevel.name: Jelly Glow Garden
newLevel.idea: A soft pink jelly garden of floaty low ceilings and bouncy jelly caps where chained flips and Puff Dash reveal hidden glow pearls.

notIncluded.idea: Open-world multiplayer reef to swim together
notIncluded.reason: Too big and not possible in single-player side-view kit with no netcode; keep cozy solo journey for now.

seasons.notes: Kept Season 1 levels, palette, flipbloom and gravity-flip; added Jelly Glow Garden with jellycap platforms, puff-dash speed powerup, and Shellby turtle buddy drawn in HUD with shield forgiveness.
